description: Use the JASP Distributions module to model the 'Anxiety' variable from the 'Exam Anxiety' dataset. First, load the dataset from '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/ExamAnxiety.csv'. Then, using the 'Distributions > Continuous > Fit' analysis, fit both 'Normal' and 'Gamma' distributions to the 'Anxiety' data. Ensure parameter estimation is enabled. Finally, save the project as '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/Anxiety_Distributions.jasp'.
